note_en: 还不如 + action means "might as well …; it would be better to …": the speaker weighs two options and picks the second as the lesser evil. In the text: 说了实话，妈妈又要唠叨半天，还不如说个小谎，让她安心 "tell the truth and Mom will nag for ages — better to tell a little lie and put her mind at ease." The rejected option often comes first, introduced by 比起 "compared with": 比起让父母连夜坐几百公里的火车赶过来，他还不如一个人把病扛过去.
